description: This source file defines the AggregateProcessor class and its companion object, responsible for managing the processing of aggregate functions within a window frame in Apache Spark SQL. It includes methods for initialization, updating, and evaluating aggregate buffers, and handles different types of aggregate functions including declarative and imperative.

classes.name: AggregateProcessor
classes.description: Manages the processing of aggregate functions within a window frame, including initialization, updating, and evaluation of aggregate buffers.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Constructs an AggregateProcessor instance based on provided aggregate functions, attributes, and projection builder.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the aggregate buffer, optionally setting the partition size.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the aggregate buffer with new input row data.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the aggregate buffer and writes the result to the target row.
